## Version 1.0: Oxidase routine mirroring the hydrolase preprocessing - 08.10.2026 | JM
## Purpose: Process raw plate reader files of photometric oxidase assays (TMB) into phenol oxidase and peroxidase activities per sample

# Step 1: Prepare session
## Step 1a: Install necessary packages
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#install.packages("here")
#install.packages("readxl")
#install.packages("tidyverse")
```

## Step 1b: Load necessary packages
```{r, message=FALSE}
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Step 1c: Define settings
```{r}
# Folders and files
path_raw       <- here("data", "oxidases", "raw")
path_metadata  <- here("data", "oxidases", "metadata", "df_oxidases_metadata.xlsx")
path_processed <- here("data", "oxidases", "processed")

# Assay constants
homogenate_ml     <- 0.1   # Volume of sample suspension per well [mL]
read_interval_min <- 15    # Time between two reads [min]; read 1 is the start (t0)
max_time_min      <- 60    # Last time point used for the slope [min]; lower it to drop non-linear reads
min_r_squared     <- 0.98  # Minimum r² of the regression line (protocol: > 0.98)

# Metadata id of negative controls (buffer instead of sample suspension)
negative_control_id <- "negative_control"
```

# Step 2: Load data
## Step 2a: Load metadata
```{r}
# One row per sample on a plate (position 1-8 = plate row A-H)
df_oxidases_0_metadata <- read_excel(path_metadata) %>%
  mutate(
    id            = as.character(id),
    sampling_date = as_date(sampling_date)
  )

df_oxidases_0_metadata
```

## Step 2b: Load raw plate reader data
```{r}
# Every .xlsx file in the raw folder is one plate (Excel lock files "~$..." are skipped)
plate_files <- list.files(path_raw, pattern = ".xlsx", full.names = TRUE) %>%
  str_subset(fixed("~$"), negate = TRUE)

# Read all plates into one table. Each file holds one 8 x 12 block per read;
# the last column names the read, e.g. "Read 1:630" (read 1 at 630 nm).
df_oxidases_1_raw <- plate_files %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map(read_excel,
      col_names = c("row_letter", paste0("col_", 1:12), "read"),
      col_types = c("text", rep("numeric", 12), "text")) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "file")

# Keep the plate rows A-H and add plate name, position and time of each read
df_oxidases_1_raw <- df_oxidases_1_raw %>%
  filter(row_letter %in% c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H")) %>%
  mutate(
    plate    = str_remove(basename(file), fixed(".xlsx")),
    position = match(row_letter, LETTERS),          # A = 1, B = 2, ... H = 8
    read     = parse_number(read),                  # "Read 1:630" -> 1
    time_min = (read - 1) * read_interval_min       # Read 1 = 0 min
  ) %>%
  select(plate, position, read, time_min, col_1:col_12)

# Reads and their times per plate
df_oxidases_1_raw %>%
  distinct(plate, read, time_min)
```

# Step 3: Assign wells to treatments
## Step 3a: Average technical replicates
```{r}
# Plate layout - each plate row is one sample, each treatment has three
# technical replicates side by side:
#
#   col 1-3     col 4-6              col 7-9            col 10-12
#   assay       homogenate control   assay + H2O2       homogenate control + H2O2
#
# Assay = sample + substrate (TMB); homogenate control = sample + buffer

df_oxidases_2_means <- df_oxidases_1_raw %>%
  mutate(
    assay                   = (col_1 + col_2 + col_3) / 3,
    homogenate_control      = (col_4 + col_5 + col_6) / 3,
    assay_h2o2              = (col_7 + col_8 + col_9) / 3,
    homogenate_control_h2o2 = (col_10 + col_11 + col_12) / 3
  ) %>%
  select(plate, position, read, time_min,
         assay, homogenate_control, assay_h2o2, homogenate_control_h2o2)

df_oxidases_2_means
```

## Step 3b: Calculate net absorbance per enzyme
```{r}
# Phenol oxidase: wells without H2O2
df_phenol_oxidase <- df_oxidases_2_means %>%
  mutate(
    enzyme         = "phenol_oxidase",
    net_absorbance = assay - homogenate_control
  )

# Total activity of phenol oxidase and peroxidase: wells with H2O2
df_total_oxidase <- df_oxidases_2_means %>%
  mutate(
    enzyme         = "total_oxidase",
    net_absorbance = assay_h2o2 - homogenate_control_h2o2
  )

# Peroxidase: total activity minus phenol oxidase
df_peroxidase <- df_oxidases_2_means %>%
  mutate(
    enzyme         = "peroxidase",
    net_absorbance = (assay_h2o2 - homogenate_control_h2o2) - (assay - homogenate_control)
  )

# Combine all enzymes: one line per sample, enzyme and read
df_oxidases_3_net <- bind_rows(df_phenol_oxidase, df_peroxidase, df_total_oxidase) %>%
  select(plate, position, enzyme, read, time_min, net_absorbance)

df_oxidases_3_net
```

# Step 4: Calculate enzyme activities
## Step 4a: Check that metadata and raw data match
```{r}
# Each check shows the problematic lines - an empty table means everything is fine

# Check 1: plate positions listed twice in the metadata
df_oxidases_0_metadata %>%
  count(plate, position) %>%
  filter(n > 1)

# Check 2: plates in the raw folder without metadata (these are not processed)
df_oxidases_1_raw %>%
  distinct(plate) %>%
  anti_join(df_oxidases_0_metadata, by = "plate")

# Check 3: samples in the metadata without raw data
df_oxidases_0_metadata %>%
  anti_join(df_oxidases_1_raw, by = c("plate", "position"))
```

## Step 4b: Calculate the change of absorbance over time
```{r}
# Linear regression of net absorbance on time for each sample and enzyme:
#   slope_per_min = slope of the regression line (= covariance / variance)
#   r_squared     = coefficient of determination of the regression line
df_oxidases_4_slopes <- df_oxidases_3_net %>%
  filter(time_min <= max_time_min) %>%
  group_by(plate, position, enzyme) %>%
  summarise(
    n_reads       = n(),
    slope_per_min = cov(time_min, net_absorbance) / var(time_min),
    r_squared     = cor(time_min, net_absorbance)^2,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_oxidases_4_slopes
```

## Step 4c: Merge metadata and slopes
```{r}
# One line per sample and enzyme
df_oxidases_5_merged <- df_oxidases_0_metadata %>%
  left_join(df_oxidases_4_slopes, by = c("plate", "position"))
```

## Step 4d: Calculate activities
```{r}
df_oxidases_6_activity <- df_oxidases_5_merged %>%
  mutate(
    # Sample per well [g]
    sample_per_well_g = sample_g * homogenate_ml / buffer_ml,

    # Activity per g sample [E630 g-1 h-1]; per g dry soil when sample_g is the
    # dry weight equivalent of the weighed soil, as in the protocol
    activity = slope_per_min * 60 / sample_per_well_g
  )
```

## Step 4e: Quality control
```{r}
# Samples are flagged instead of removed, so that every sample stays in the output
df_oxidases_7_processed <- df_oxidases_6_activity %>%
  mutate(
    qc_flag = case_when(
      id == negative_control_id  ~ "negative control",
      is.na(activity)            ~ "missing assay data",
      activity <= 0              ~ "activity <= 0",
      r_squared < min_r_squared  ~ "r2 below limit",
      .default = "ok"
    )
  )

# Negative controls: the slopes should be close to zero
df_oxidases_7_processed %>%
  filter(id == negative_control_id) %>%
  select(id, plate, position, enzyme, slope_per_min, r_squared)

# Show all samples that did not pass the quality control
df_oxidases_7_processed %>%
  filter(qc_flag != "ok", id != negative_control_id) %>%
  select(id, plate, position, enzyme, slope_per_min, r_squared, activity, qc_flag)
```

# Step 5: Save processed data
```{r}
dir.create(path_processed, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_csv(df_oxidases_7_processed,
          file.path(path_processed, "df_oxidases_processed.csv"))
```

# Step 6: Summary of dataframes
```{r}
# Number of samples per enzyme and quality flag
df_oxidases_7_processed %>%
  count(enzyme, qc_flag)

# Activities of the samples that passed the quality control
df_oxidases_7_processed %>%
  filter(qc_flag == "ok") %>%
  group_by(enzyme) %>%
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    mean = mean(activity),
    min  = min(activity),
    max  = max(activity)
  )
```
